summary: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (i7 13700HX, 4050) is experiencing rapid battery degradation, characterized by rapid discharge from 100% to 6% in under 1 minute and instantaneous charging back to 100%. The issue has persisted despite user attempts at troubleshooting, including battery calibration and CMOS reset.
detected_fault: Rapid battery degradation due to potential hardware failure (battery pack or charging circuit) or software/driver issues.
suggested_solution: Replace the battery pack or perform a thorough diagnostic test to identify any underlying hardware issues and address them accordingly.
